name: Visual Kei
garments: theatrical costuming blending punk, glam and historical references

media.title: X Japan (band, formed 1982)
media.note: widely credited as the genre-defining act

media.title: Malice Mizer
media.note: key act for the gothic/elegant strand that fed into gothic-lolita crossover

reacts_against: conventional Japanese gender presentation in pop music, using extreme androgynous visual spectacle as a core part of the genre's identity, not a costume side effect.
revivals: ongoing: visual kei has had a continuous, evolving scene since the 1980s rather than a single revival

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Androgyny, elaborate costumes, dramatic makeup, extravagant hairstyles (often brightly colored and spiked), historical and fantastical themes
wiki_facts.key_colours: Varies widely by sub-genre, from all-black to vibrant, multi-colored palettes
wiki_facts.key_values: Visual self-expression, artistic freedom, theatricality, rebellion against conformity, musical diversity

findings: dark — about 77% of the measured color across 6 wiki images is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 74% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
